tasks.do: THE CONTRACT (decision 75), the same list in Sessions A and B: (1) every play phase that gives an order opens with the shared request pop-up, read out, then folds into the sidebar; (2) where the outcome is obvious the game moves on by itself: no ✓, Next or stage button appears after a step is already complete; (3) every stage and game end stops all voice: no line starts or keeps playing after its stage ended; (4) every speech bubble sits above (or, without room, below) its speaker's head; (5) end-screen badges appear one, two, three in order; (6) no old art is drawn where a replacement exists (the old hand-and-knife, a standing Nani behind a cut-out counter). Build items 1-5 once, in the shared layer, so no game can skip them: the shared host (or one shared lifecycle module both Cook and the clinic call at every stage boundary) runs the pop-up before play, the auto-advance, the voice stop and the end screen; a game supplies only its play. Remove each game's own copy of these behaviours. Do not change what any mini-game asks the child to do (non-negotiable 2).
